proposed_comments.title: Respect the GitHub rate-limit cooldown (1/3)
proposed_comments.body:
### Respect the GitHub rate-limit cooldown (1/3)

**Severity:** `medium`

A 429 response enters the same 1-second/2-second retry loop as a transient network failure. GitHub requires respecting its rate-limit cooldown (including Retry-After), but GetStringAsync does not expose those response headers here; these automatic retries can therefore run before the permitted time. Fail fast on 429, as for 403, so the existing error handling and manual Retry remain available without guessing a cooldown. See [GitHub rate-limit guidance](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/best-practices-for-using-the-rest-api#handle-rate-limit-errors-appropriately).

```suggestion
                code is HttpStatusCode.RequestTimeout || (int)code >= 500,
```

Apply all three related suggestions together as one batch.

confidence.rationale: Exact upstream retry path and GitHub cooldown contract; original classifier fails the 429 regression while the minimal correction passes both statuses without delay.

proposed_comments.body:
### Align the 429 classifier expectation (3/3)

**Severity:** `medium`

The classifier assertion currently requires 429 to be retryable, which contradicts failing fast when GitHub rate-limits the request. Update this expectation alongside the classifier and the parameterized retry regression; network failures, timeouts, 408 and server errors remain retryable.

```suggestion
            Assert.IsFalse(ScoobeWindow.IsTransientFetchFailure(new HttpRequestException(null, null, HttpStatusCode.TooManyRequests)));
```

Apply all three related suggestions together as one batch.
